stem.text: The diagram shows the structure of a unicellular organism.

stem.alt: Outline of a unicellular organism with labelled nucleus, vacuole, mitochondria, cytoplasm and cell membrane.

stem.text: Which statement is correct for this organism?

A.text: It contains a nucleus so it is **not** prokaryotic.

B.text: It contains mitochondria so it is **not** a plant.

C.text: It does **not** have a cell wall so it must be eukaryotic.

D.text: It is unicellular so it must be a bacterium.
